summary: A restricted MTT/Ranta comparison. Both have CN types and strong Sigma packages; strong_some_agree and strong_witness_agree expose that shared structure. Weak Prop-existential versus Sigma requires inhabited mediation, a difference between selected constructors rather than an MTT expressivity limitation. Donkey readings agree on the shared Prop-valued lexicon; coercive-subtyping and sugaring mechanisms remain distinct.
